sections.text_helper: Section 13.1 "PWR introduction" in chapter 13 (Power control (PWR)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 347.
sections.section_content:
This section gives an overview of the supply architecture for thedifferent power domains
and of the supply configuration controller. It also describes the features of the power-supply
supervisors, and explains how theVCOREsupply domain is configured, depending upon the
operating modes, the selected performance (clock frequency), and the voltage scaling.
